migration_and_rollback.projection_note: This packet changes only the existing canonical multi-relation compiler, focused tests and the existing reference contract. Reverting the implementation commit restores the prior lossy undirected reverse-expansion behavior without changing branch topology or historical evidence.

title: Refuse lossy undirected Forest projection in the canonical relation compiler

masterplan.gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

issue_scope.priority: align the canonical multi-relation compiler with the existing strict Fourfold projection contract by refusing lossy undirected ForestEdge flattening while preserving selected-evidence pruning and avoiding a parallel directionality abstraction

implementation.summary: compile_relation_blocks no longer turns one undirected ForestEdge into invented forward/reverse directed relation facts. Discover-all and an explicitly requested forward or reverse signature that would depend on the undirected edge now fail closed. An explicitly selected unrelated relation prunes the undirected source edge and can still compile independently.
implementation.gardener_note: The previous optional reverse signature carried through edge_records and the reverse _record_fact branch were removed. Directionality refusal stays inside the existing compiler owner; no second compiler, graph schema, directionality adapter, cache, backend, registry, fact store or public API was introduced.
implementation.semantic_boundary: TypedRelationBlock is directional. Because ForestEdge.directed=false retains a different semantic claim, the compiler refuses rather than pretending two directed facts are equivalent. This matches the existing strict Forest/Fourfold projection policy and retains source receipt cardinality even when an unrelated explicit selection prunes the undirected edge.
implementation.selected_pruning: Explicitly unrelated selections skip undirected source evidence before _forest_edge_atoms materialization; matching forward/reverse selections and discover-all fail before evidence materialization.

focused_contracts: discover-all refuses an undirected ForestEdge before evidence materialization
an explicitly selected matching same-plane relation refuses rather than flattening the undirected edge
an explicitly selected reverse cross-plane signature refuses rather than inventing the reverse direction
an explicitly selected unrelated directed relation compiles while the undirected edge is pruned without evidence materialization
Forest source cardinality remains visible in the receipt even when an unrelated explicit selection prunes the undirected edge
existing endpoint-completeness, retained-hyperedge and observer semantics remain on the same canonical compiler path
